visualCharacteristics: A vertical list of bordered link rows, each with a title, optional description and a right-hand arrow. The plain variant shows simple rows with a document icon and a blue rule.
contentPattern: One row per item: a paragraph with the link (the description may be authored as <em> inside the link) and an optional second paragraph with a description.
usage: Use for a stacked list of related links or documents, optionally with a short description per link.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any vertical list of text links; pick entry-links for boxed entry points or cards when items carry images.
